jobs.occupation: Postdoktor vid avdelningen för molekylär skelettbiologi
jobs.description:
Workplace descriptionThe projects will be performed within the Cell, Tissue and Organ Engineering group led by Dr. Paul Bourgine. Bone is a complex Organ offering structural and mechanical support of our body but also consisting in our principal hematopoietic center. The formation of Bone involves distinct stages, including cartilage, vasculature, bone and bone marrow establishment. The Bourgine lab aims at compiling human-specific knowledge on these processes, toward the development of innovative Regenerative Therapies.
Within the research group, we are committed to fostering a positive work environment characterized by respect and consideration in our relationships with one another. We continuously strive to create conditions that promote job satisfaction, professional development, and inclusion for all employees.
We are now seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher for a full-time fixed-term position, with a start date of 1st of February 2027 or by agreement.
What we offerLund University is a government agency, which means you will receive special benefits, generous annual leave, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university’s website about working at Lund University: Work with us.
Duties and responsibilitiesThe Postdoctoral Researcher will work with the following tasks:
Development of novel culture systems for tissue engineering.
Isolation and differentiation of primary human cells.
Identification of cellular and molecular events throughout stages of endochondral ossification.

Other responsibilities and work tasks may also be relevant.
Eligibility requirementsTo be eligible for a postdoctoral position, you must have a PhD or a foreign degree deemed equivalent to a PhD. This requirement must be fulfilled at the time of the employment decision, and proof must be submitted by that date. Exceptions can be made in cases such as parental leave, illness, clinical duties, union commitments, or similar.
Assessment criteriaAt Lund University, postdoctoral positions are intended to provide opportunities for academic qualification. The position primarily allows for research merit, but also includes limited higher education teaching. Teaching may be included in the role. The main assessment criterion is scientific expertise in the subject area.
Required qualificationsThe position requires:
PhD in Biology or Bioengineering
Documented postdoctoral experiences in different laboratories
At least three publications as first author in a peer-reviewed journal 
Documented experience in vascular biology and engineering of vessels
Robust experience in 3D culture applied to ossification
Strong laboratory and analytical skills, with the ability to work both independently and within an interdisciplinary team.
Robust experience in culture and differentiation of human primary cells in 2D and 3D
Experience in microfluidics and microscopy
Experience in prototyping with AutoCAD
Good knowledge of English (written and spoken).

Merits include:
Experience with human mesenchymal cell culture and differentiation
Background in biomaterials science and/or polymer synthesis.
Experience with 3D printing/additive manufacturing and associated software
Experience as executive member of scientific societies 

Terms of employment
This is a fixed-term, full-time position for two years, starting on 2027-02-01 or as agreed.Employment at Lund University takes place in Sweden, and you are therefore expected to carry out your work on site in Lund.
The appointment is limited to a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years, in accordance with the collective agreement on fixed-term employment as a postdoc (Arbetsgivarverket). A postdoctoral position is intended as an initial step in a research career and an opportunity to deepen and broaden research expertise.
Application instructionsYour application should include:
A cover letter describing your interest in the project, how you meet the required qualifications (including previous independent projects and technical skills), your research interests, and your future career plans
A CV including names and contact details of two former supervisors
A complete publication list (can be included in your CV)
A copy of your diploma (PhD or equivalent)

We warmly welcome your application!
Mer om Medicinska fakulteten
Medicinska fakulteten är ett verksamhetsområde inom Lunds universitet, med ansvar för utbildning och forskning inom medicin, vård och hälsa. Utbildningen sker i nära samverkan med sjukvården och är väl förankrad i fakultetens starka forskningstradition. Fakultetens forskning spänner över ett brett fält inom experimentell grundforskning, patientnära klinisk forskning och hälsovetenskaplig forskning. Medicinska fakulteten, med drygt 1800 anställda och 3000 studenter i Lund, Malmö och Helsingborg, är en kunskapsintensiv mötesplats för studenter, lärare och forskare från hela världen.
Vi undanber oss alla kontakter från annonsförsäljare, rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag på grund av statliga upphandlingsregler.

Hydraulic components and assemblies;

Coordinate product market-introduction activities, including:
Product testing
Product certification
Technical documentation

Education:
M.SC – Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

Experience in the design of hydraulic components and circuits, including plastic and metallic parts, preferably using CAD 3D Siemens Unigraphics (NX).

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Ownership, initiative, and a structured approach to developing solutions

Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments
Clear, precise, and structured communicator, able to explain complex topics effectively

jobs.occupation: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
jobs.description:
TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.
Why Lovable?
Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
What we’re looking for
Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.
A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.
Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.
Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.
Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.
Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.
A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.

What you’ll do
Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.
Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.
Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.
Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.
Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.
Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.
Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.

Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.

jobs.occupation: Sales Coordinator to an International Company in the MedTech Industry!
jobs.description:

Do you have experience in order management, sales support, or B2B administration? Are you someone who likes to take responsibility and ensure that everything runs smoothly from start to finish? This is much more than an order administration position. You will be responsible for keeping the entire process together, identifying potential issues, coordinating different departments, and ensuring that every order is handled correctly and within the agreed timeframe.

Receive, review, and register customer orders, primarily via email.
Ensure that order documentation, pricing, and delivery terms are accurate and complete.
Communicate with customers and sales representatives to clarify or obtain missing order information.
Coordinate complex orders involving multiple factories, deliveries, and internal functions.
Monitor order progress and ensure that products are delivered according to schedule.
Collaborate with service coordinators and project managers to prepare for product installations.
Ensure a smooth and accurate handover to the service organization.
Follow up on open orders and ensure that invoicing takes place at the correct time.
Manage partial deliveries and invoicing in multiple stages.
Communicate deviations and changes in invoicing schedules to the finance department.
Take ownership of your orders and ensure that each process is followed through to completion.

We are looking for someone with previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.

Previous experience in order coordination, order management, sales support, or qualified B2B customer service.
Experience independently managing and following up on order processes, preferably from order placement through to delivery and invoicing.
An understanding of how orders, deliveries, installations, and invoicing are connected.
Experience coordinating several internal and external stakeholders.
The ability to manage complex cases and keep multiple processes moving simultaneously.
Previous experience working with ERP or other business management systems.
Good general computer skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
Excellent communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

jobs.occupation: Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer
jobs.description:
The Lead Mechanical / Piping Commissioning Engineer will report to the Commissioning & Start-Up (CSU) Manager and lead the commissioning, start-up and performance testing of mechanical equipment and piping systems.
The role requires extensive knowledge of static and rotating equipment, piping systems, nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping testing and associated commissioning activities. Strong technical, organisational and leadership skills are essential to manage mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover in accordance with project requirements, industry standards and HSSE expectations.
Key Responsibilities
Commissioning & Start-Up
Lead commissioning and start-up activities for mechanical equipment and piping systems, coordinating with multidisciplinary project teams.
Develop and execute commissioning plans, schedules, procedures and test requirements covering mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning and start-up.
Coordinate system readiness and commissioning priorities in line with project schedules and operational requirements.
Support plant start-up, performance testing and transition to stable operations.

Mechanical & Piping Technical Leadership
Provide technical leadership for static and rotating equipment and associated piping systems.
Oversee nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management, piping integrity testing and other pre-commissioning activities.
Ensure mechanical and piping systems comply with approved engineering specifications, relevant standards and project requirements.
Review system configuration, piping arrangements, test requirements and commissioning documentation.
Provide technical guidance to commissioning engineers, contractors and vendor representatives.

Testing & Inspection
Oversee testing and inspection of mechanical equipment and piping systems to verify integrity, functionality and readiness.
Ensure piping test packages, leak testing and mechanical inspection activities are completed and documented.
Verify completion of required inspections and tests prior to system energisation, introduction of process media or start-up.
Monitor deficiencies and ensure outstanding items are addressed before handover.

Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution
Identify and resolve mechanical and piping issues encountered during pre-commissioning and commissioning.
Work with engineering, construction, vendors and operations teams to investigate faults and implement appropriate solutions.
Identify technical constraints affecting system readiness and escalate critical issues where required.

Documentation & Handover
Maintain accurate commissioning records, including test results, checklists, punch lists and relevant as-built documentation.
Ensure commissioning documentation and completion evidence are accurate, traceable and ready for handover.
Manage punch-list close-out and support system walkdowns and acceptance activities.
Support final system handover to operations.

Performance Testing
Lead mechanical and piping aspects of plant performance testing.
Verify systems and equipment meet defined performance and operational criteria.
Support optimisation and corrective activities identified during start-up and performance testing.

HSSE & Compliance
Ensure commissioning activities comply with project HSSE requirements, industry standards and applicable regulations.
Promote safe working practices and a strong safety culture throughout mechanical and piping commissioning.
Ensure appropriate controls are applied to pressure testing, leak testing and other high-risk commissioning activities.

Stakeholder & Team Coordination
Collaborate with the CSU Manager, engineering, construction, operations, vendors, contractors and other commissioning disciplines.
Coordinate commissioning interfaces and ensure activities align with overall project objectives and schedules.
Provide leadership, technical guidance and mentoring to commissioning personnel.
Identify opportunities to improve commissioning methods, system readiness and execution efficiency.

Technical Skills
Extensive knowledge of static and rotating mechanical equipment and piping systems.
Strong expertise in nitrogen-helium leak testing, flange management and piping integrity testing.
Knowledge of mechanical completion, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and performance testing.
Strong understanding of relevant ASME, ANSI and API standards.
Experience with piping and commissioning systems/software; SmartPlant or Hexagon experience is advantageous.
Strong planning, scheduling, resource management and project coordination capability.
API 570, ASME B31.3 or other relevant mechanical/piping certification is advantageous.
Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills.

Qualifications & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 10 years' experience commissioning mechanical equipment and piping systems within major industrial projects.
Demonstrable experience with static and rotating equipment, piping systems, mechanical completion and commissioning.
Proven expertise in leak testing, flange management, piping testing, pre-commissioning, start-up and plant performance testing.
Strong knowledge of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to mechanical and piping systems.
Ability to lead commissioning activities within complex, fast-paced project environments.
Strong communication, leadership and stakeholder-management skills.
Proficiency with relevant commissioning systems and software.
Green hydrogen and/or green steel experience is advantageous.
Project management experience or qualifications are advantageous.
Fluent English required; Swedish language skills are advantageous but not essential.

jobs.occupation: Line Manager for Dynamic Control Design

Planning for project staffing and adjusting it according to business needs, as well as planning for both short-term and more strategic long-term changes in the team structure.

jobs.occupation: Account Executive for Ecoroute
jobs.description:
Are you driven, business‑oriented, and eager to grow within B2B sales? We are now looking for an Account Executive who will have the opportunity to be part of scaling a new, AI‑driven product within a European software group. You’ll take on a central role in a successful and ambitious team, with strong opportunities to develop and make a real impact. Sounds interesting? Keep on reading!
Movement Software is a Northern European software group focused on niched industry verticals. In our Transport, Logistics & Geodata vertical, Ecoroute/Tetrasoft, Geposit, Postnummerservice, and Dimaps form a strong ecosystem of specialized software companies. Through close collaboration, they deliver complementary solutions that help businesses improve efficiency, gain better control, and navigate an increasingly complex world.
In our companies, we develop data‑driven software solutions that solve real operational challenges for our customers. Our value-adding offering includes address & geodata solutions, geographical management tools, last‑meter delivery planning & production systems and route optimization & delivery execution platforms. Our customers are mainly within transportation, logistics, and field services – but we also help companies in other industries as well.
With our newly developed next-generation platform, Ecoroute, we are redefining how companies plan, optimize and execute their daily transportation operations. From route optimization to real-time execution, we help our customers reduce costs, improve service levels, and make better decisions every day.
About the role As an Account Executive you will play a key role in driving the growth across Sweden and other Nordic and Northern European countries. You will own the full sales cycle from first contact to signed deal, working closely with decision-makers in transport, logistics, and field service industries. You will collaborate with product and customer teams to ensure a strong fit and high-quality customer experience.
You will be part of an ambitious, high-performance environment where we push each other to improve and win together. The position is based in Malmö, Sweden, located at one of our sister companies to ensure close collaboration to Geopt’s Chief Commercial Officer, who is based in Denmark.
Your responsibilities:

Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of potential customers.

Lead customer meetings, both digital and in person, an demonstrate the value of our offerings – with particular focus on Ecoroute.

Drive negotiations and close new deals.

Work closely with your colleagues within the Customer Success and Product teams to ensure successful onboarding and long-term value for the customer.

Provide market feedback and insights that shape product and commercial development.

Who we are looking for We are looking for someone who is proactive, ambitious, and results-driven – with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to move deals forward. You will thrive in this role if you have experience with B2B sales, preferably within SaaS. We also believe that you have:

A strong set of communication skills and the ability to build trust quickly.

A comprehensive and solution‑oriented mindset.

Natural authority and execution power, combined with a positive and pragmatic attitude.

Hunter mentality.

"Grit" – you don't give up, even when the work presents challenges.

The ability to communicate fluently in both Swedish and English.

A valid driver’s license.

Experience from the transportation or logistics industry is considered a plus, as well as the ability to “speak tech,” such as understanding APIs, integrations, and technical concepts.
Interested? Contact us! Does this sound like a role and environment that would suit you? Apply, connect with us, or share this opportunity with someone you think might be a great fit.
If you have questions, reach out to Linnea Olsson, People Business Partner at Movement Software.
We are a part of Movement Software
Ecoroute is part of Movement Software (formerly Progrits), a Northern European software group consisting of around twenty entrepreneur-led companies across three business areas: Vehicle digital solutions, Transport & logistics, and the public mobility. Since 2023, Movement Software has been part of Axcel, a Nordic private equity firm with a strong focus on the technology sector.
Being part of Movement Software provides us with greater opportunities for growth and development, both as a company and as individuals, while also offering the stability and resources of a larger group.

jobs.occupation: Sales Representative  Flygprestanda AB
jobs.description:
Take your sales career to new heights in aviation technology!
About Flygprestanda
Since 1969, Flygprestanda AB has been at the forefront of aviation performance technology. With decades of industry expertise, we develop innovative Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) solutions that help airlines and aircraft operators worldwide perform safe and efficient takeoff and landing performance calculations.
Based in central Malmö, we combine deep aviation knowledge with cutting-edge technology to deliver solutions that make a real difference in aviation safety.
Now, we're looking for a motivated and commercially minded Sales Representative to join our close-knit Sales & Marketing team and help us reach new heights.

The opportunity
Are you a natural communicator who enjoys building relationships, discovering new business opportunities, and turning conversations into successful partnerships? Are you curious about technology and excited by the prospect of working with customers around the world?
As our Sales Representative, you'll play a key role in driving growth and expanding our international customer base. You'll connect with prospective and existing customers, present innovative software solutions, and help airlines and aircraft operators discover how our technology can support their operations.
This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll combine proactive sales, customer engagement, online product demonstrations, and account management. You'll also work closely with colleagues across engineering, software development, finance, and marketing, gaining valuable insight into both our products and the aviation industry.
What you'll be doing
Create new business opportunities by following up on inbound leads and reaching out to prospective and existing customers through calls and emails.
Build lasting customer relationships by understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities, and providing a professional, responsive experience.
Drive sales forward by preparing commercial proposals, negotiating offers, and closing deals to achieve sales targets.
Showcase our technology by delivering engaging online demonstrations that bring the benefits of our software to life.
Support our customers and sales pipeline through account administration and accurate maintenance of customer and prospect databases.
Discover new opportunities through market research, industry insights, and competitor analysis.
Collaborate across teams to ensure a smooth customer journey, from the first conversation to a successful partnership.

Who we're looking for
We're looking for someone who is proactive, organized, and motivated by results. You enjoy taking initiative, communicating with people, and finding solutions that create value for customers.
You don't shy away from picking up the phone, following up on opportunities, or starting conversations with new prospects. You're equally comfortable working independently and contributing to a collaborative team environment.
You may already have experience in sales, or you may be ready to take the next step in your commercial career. An interest in technology, digital solutions, or aviation would be a great advantage.
You'll bring:
Previous sales experience and a genuine interest in developing new business.
Excellent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with international customers.
Strong listening and interpersonal skills, with a customer-first mindset.
Experience using CRM systems and MS Office or LibreOffice.
The ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and organize your working day.
A structured, thorough, and solution-oriented approach to your work.
A positive team spirit and a professional attitude.

Experience in the aviation industry and a degree in business or a related field are advantageous, but not essential. Some international travel may be required.
Why join Flygprestanda?
International reach: Work with airlines and aircraft operators across the world.
Meaningful technology: Represent software solutions that contribute to safe aviation operations.
A varied role: Combine sales, customer relationships, technology, and market development.
A collaborative environment: Work closely with knowledgeable colleagues across multiple disciplines.
A strong industry foundation: Join a company with a long history of aviation expertise and a forward-looking approach to technology.

Practical information
Location: Central Malmö, Sweden
Salary: Starting from SEK 34,000 per month
Travel: Some international travel may be required
Ready for takeoff?
If you're driven by sales, enjoy building international relationships, and want to work at the intersection of technology and aviation, we'd love to hear from you.
Send your CV and personal letter to **careers@flygp.se** not later than 28/11-2026.
Questions about the role? Contact Åke Grundemar at 040-642 00 26 or 0765-262 626, or email quality@flygp.se.
Note: This position may be appointed prior to above stated deadline.
